subject: Manager source review: Gen5 visual clock has a safe existing insertion seam; current opening effect is a canned 90ms follower ramp
body: Against current main bfbf5d68: semantic early opening is accepted by Fold7ContinuityCoordinator before FoldOverlayService calls Fold7Gen3VisualCoordinator.beginOpening(generation). Gen3 movement already carries serviceEpoch/movementId/generation and owns only the visual attempt. PanelEngine.beginContinuityOpeningVisual starts at COVER_OPEN_IMMEDIATE_TILT, then current explicit opening sets TiltFollower tau=0.09s and target=MAX_TILT. While continuity owns Fold7 cover geometry, PanelEngine.onHinge records the real angle but returns without retargeting the opening visual. Conclusion: Gen5 should replace this visual target path with per-vsync visual-only virtual-hinge output inside the generation-fenced Gen3 visual attempt. It must NOT feed synthetic angles into HingeAngleSource, Fold7HingeIngressBatch, Fold7ContinuityController, Gen4 daemon authority, or terminal handoff. At trusted confidence bypass TiltFollower to avoid double smoothing; retain measured/follower fallback for degraded confidence. Separate source finding for Lane B: DuoShader.concurrentCoverTiltForHinge half-sine spans ~0.5..135deg and peaks at ~67.75deg, so it is not the requested ~90deg Gen5 glass envelope and should not be reused unchanged.
